How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Executive Secretary post at IIT Madras is 22 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Executive Secretary position in the IIT Madras recruitment drive. This offers a focused opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment 2026 is online. Interested candidates must apply through the official website as per the instructions provided.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Executive Secretary position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree. A Master's degree is optional, and a minimum of 3 years of experience in executive administrative support is required for this role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Executive Secretary post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The salary for the Executive Secretary position starts from Rs. 20,000/- per month, with potential for increase based on experience and performance, as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment 2026, making it accessible for all applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Executive Secretary role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a test or interview, and finally document verification for selected candidates to ensure eligibility and suitability.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Executive Secretary position be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the Executive Secretary post is Chennai, Tamil Nadu, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras campus, offering a vibrant academic environment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for applying and finding more details about the IIT Madras Executive Secretary Recruitment is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in. All official updates will be available there.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply for the Executive Secretary post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates holding a Master's degree are eligible and may also apply for the Executive Secretary position, provided they meet other essential criteria such as experience and age limits.
